limitations: Does not classify all maximal product-one-free unit sequences up to automorphism
Restricted to binary truncated polynomial rings
Residual risk of an earlier general inverse-semigroup theorem
scientific_integrity: The exact unrestricted Davenport constant is already implied by Deng (2016); the distinct claim is the nonunit-stratified extremal length law and inverse parity rigidity, proved here. Finite verification is not an infinite proof. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Nonunit-stratified Davenport extrema and parity rigidity in binary truncated polynomial rings
